summary: Apply revocation only from a successful check
description: FR-C7-09, FR-C7-10, P7, and OD-8. The revocation check is off when revocation_url is empty. A timeout or error does not change state. Only a successful body that says revoked does.
scope: revocation_enabled is false when the URL is empty
A revoked true body sets state revoked
A timeout leaves the previous state
acceptanceCriteria: revocation_url None means the check is off. Body {revoked: true} changes active to revoked. A TimeoutError argument leaves active unchanged. The outbound body has only license_id and org_id. FR-C7-09 FR-C7-10 P7 OD-8.
constraints: Do not block when the revocation server errors.
Do not send prompts, user ids, or token counts in the revocation body.
Do not turn the check on when revocation_url is empty.
